env-loglevel.file: .env, edit this value and preserve other settings

env-recreate.unix:
docker compose up -d --force-recreate api
docker compose logs --tail 100 api

env-verify.unix:
docker compose exec api printenv LOG_LEVEL
./openldr health --json
env-verify.windows:
docker compose exec api printenv LOG_LEVEL
.\openldr.ps1 health --json
